assetRequests.label: App Store Connect app record
assetRequests.request: Create or select the macOS app record for bundle id com.sachittumuluri.codycartridge.
acceptanceCriteria: The macOS app record uses the same bundle id as package.json build.appId.
The SKU, name, category, and version metadata match APP_STORE_CONNECT_FIELDS.json.
The app record is available for TestFlight build selection after upload processing.

assetRequests.label: Application distribution signing identity
assetRequests.request: Install an Apple Distribution, Mac App Distribution, or 3rd Party Mac Developer Application certificate with its private key in the login keychain.
acceptanceCriteria: security find-identity reports at least one application distribution identity.
The private key is present locally and is not exported into the project or handoff archive.
The certificate team can match the MAS provisioning profile team.

assetRequests.label: Installer distribution signing identity
assetRequests.request: Install a Mac Installer Distribution or 3rd Party Mac Developer Installer certificate with its private key in the login keychain.
acceptanceCriteria: security find-identity reports at least one installer distribution identity.
The identity can sign the final MAS installer package.
The private key remains outside the project and handoff archive.

assetRequests.label: Mac App Store provisioning profile
assetRequests.request: Create and download a macOS/Mac App Store distribution provisioning profile for com.sachittumuluri.codycartridge.
acceptanceCriteria: The profile is unexpired and targets macOS.
The profile matches the bundle id.
The profile is distribution-style: no provisioned devices and get-task-allow=false.
The profile includes required MAS entitlements: com.apple.security.app-sandbox, com.apple.security.files.user-selected.read-only, com.apple.security.files.bookmarks.app-scope.
The profile team matches an installed distribution signing identity.

assetRequests.label: Signed current-version MAS upload package
assetRequests.request: Build the signed Mac App Store app bundle and current-version installer package on the release machine.
acceptanceCriteria: dist/mas-arm64/Cody Cartridge.app contains Contents/embedded.provisionprofile.
codesign verification succeeds for the app bundle.
The signed .pkg matches package.json version/build.
UPLOAD_COMMAND_PACKET.json selects that signed current-version package.

assetRequests.label: App Store Connect upload API key
assetRequests.ownerSystem: App Store Connect Users and Access
assetRequests.request: Create or select an App Store Connect API key permitted to upload this app, then install the private key outside the project after dry-run validation.
acceptanceCriteria: ASC_KEY_ID and ASC_ISSUER_ID are available only in the release shell or secure local environment.
The .p8 private key file is outside the project and handoff archive.
The credential preflight passes before command-line upload.
Transporter.app may be used interactively instead when command-line credentials are not configured.
